title: Fix misppellings in root, include, and ui directories
description:
Fix misppellings in root, include, and ui directories.
Most of these are comments, but some are in
error messages.

notes.body: Found by running: `codespell --skip="*.ts" | less` (note: required manual review)
changed title from **Fix misppellings in root and ui directories** to **Fix misppellings in root{+, include,+} and ui directories**
